# AyoSim

> Next-generation in-browser hardware simulation platform for Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi by AYOT.

AyoSim is an advanced, 100% client-side hardware simulation ecosystem that enables engineers, students, educators, and makers to design, program, and simulate embedded electronics and IoT architectures without physical hardware.

- Portal URL: https://ayosim.app/
- Organization: AYOT
- Supported Languages: English, French, Arabic (with native Right-to-Left RTL support)
- Platform Mode: 100% In-Browser (Zero installation, zero drivers, zero cloud compilation latency)
- Pricing Model: Freemium (Free access tier available; upcoming subscription tiers for advanced hardware and team collaboration)

## Core Simulators

- [AyoSim Arduino](https://ayosim-arduino.vercel.app/): ATmega328P 8-bit AVR virtual core @ 16 MHz (Uno R3 & Nano), in-browser C++17 Clang WebAssembly compiler, 32KB flash & 2KB SRAM profiling, 14 digital I/O, 6 PWM, 6 ADC, multi-channel Serial Plotter, and virtual EEPROM.
- [AyoSim ESP32](https://ayosim-esp32.vercel.app/): Dual-core Tensilica Xtensa LX6 @ 240 MHz, MicroPython engine with firmware version switcher (v1.19.1 to v1.29.0), FreeRTOS, virtual 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi, BLE 4.2 GATT peripheral stack, capacitive touch, and 8-bit DAC.
- [AyoSim Raspberry Pi](https://ayosim-rpi.vercel.app/): Broadcom BCM2711 quad-core Cortex-A72 @ 1.5 GHz (Raspberry Pi 4 Model B), embedded Linux kernel v6.1 & systemd rootfs, Python 3.11 runtime, dual `gpiozero` & `RPi.GPIO` APIs, and 40-pin memory-mapped GPIO.

## Standout & Exclusive Features (Absent in Other Simulators)

1. **Full Linux Raspberry Pi SBC Simulation**: Simulates the full Cortex-A72 Single Board Computer with Linux OS, bash terminal, and Python 3.11 (Wokwi only simulates the microcontroller RP2040 Pico; Tinkercad has no Raspberry Pi).
2. **Photorealistic 3D Studio with Dynamic LDR Lighting**: Three.js WebGL studio with OrbitControls where room lighting reacts in real time to the simulated LDR photoresistor, making LEDs glow realistically in the dark.
3. **Interactive In-Browser Virtual Smartphone**: Simulated mobile phone for HC-05 Bluetooth pairing (PIN 1234), BLE serial terminal, 6-button gamepad controller, PWM slider, and macro manager.
4. **Node-RED Bidirectional WebSocket Bridge**: Live telemetry streaming and remote GPIO actuation over `ws://localhost:1881/pisim` via `node-red-contrib-pisim`.
5. **Local Clang-WASM C++17 Compilation**: 100% client-side compilation in under 200 ms with zero remote server round-trips and offline execution.
6. **Destructive Burnout Physics**: Overcurrent ($I > 30\text{ mA}$) causes LEDs to physically burn out into charred black 3D meshes.
7. **Multi-Channel Serial Waveform Plotter**: Graphs up to 6 simultaneous color-coded channels with auto-scaling and key-value parsing.
8. **Mobile Embedded Keyboard Bar**: Dedicated floating punctuation bar (`{`, `}`, `(`, `)`, `;`, `\t`, quotes) for touch devices.
9. **Trilingual with Native RTL**: First-class English, French, and Arabic with true Right-to-Left mirrored layout.

## Resources & Documentation

- [Full Machine Specification & FAQ](https://ayosim.app/llms-full.txt): Deep technical specifications, comparison tables, and FAQ for LLM retrieval.

- [Tutorials](https://ayosim.app/#tutorials): 50+ guided laboratory assignments.
- [Projects](https://ayosim.app/#projects): Real-world IoT, automation, and robotics builds.
